cd /tmp; kubectl get endpoints -n social-network | awk '$2=="<none>"'; kubectl get svc -n social-network -o json | jq -r '.items[]|select(.spec.type=="ClusterIP")|"\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.ports[0].port) -> \(.spec.ports[0].targetPort)"' | awk '$2!=$4'; for p in $(kubectl get pods -n social-network -o name | grep service); do echo == $p; kubectl logs -n social-network $p --tail=5; done 2>&1 | head -80

kubectl get endpoints -n social-network | awk '$2=="<none>"'; kubectl get svc,deploy -n social-network -o custom-columns=N:.metadata.name,P:.spec.ports[*].targetPort,C:.spec.template.spec.containers[*].ports[*].containerPort | grep -v none; kubectl logs -n social-network deploy/compose-post-service | grep -v Error\] | tail

kubectl get deploy user-service -n social-network -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector} {.spec.template.metadata.labels} {.spec.template.spec.containers[0].ports}'; kubectl get svc user-timeline-service -n social-network -o yaml

kubectl apply -n social-network -f - <<E
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: user-service
  namespace: social-network
spec:
  ports:
  - name: "9090"
    port: 9090
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 9090
  selector:
    service: user-service
E
kubectl get endpoints user-service -n social-network
agent.summary:
The root cause was a missing `user-service` Kubernetes Service. Without it, nothing could resolve the hostname `user-service`. compose-post-service logged "Temporary failure in name resolution" and "Failed to connect user-service-client" on every call to it.

I created the Service on port 9090, with the selector `service: user-service`, matching the other services. It now has the user-service pod as its endpoint (`10.244.162.186:9090`). I didn't re-check the compose-post-service logs afterwards, so I haven't confirmed the errors have stopped.

Other errors in the logs were not part of the failure:
- **OTLP exporter errors:** the `otel-collector` DNS lookups fail. That only affects tracing, and I left it alone.
- **MongoDB index errors:** several services logged index-creation errors at startup. They retried and started normally.
